name: sr5b-shut-out
_comment: SR-5b (Score Mandate Chunk 5, September 28, 2026) — the standing DEF-5 evidence: the A2 strangulation arc and the Congress's SHUT OUT arm, PLAYED through POST /command (the NV-10 drive of August 2 called the executor directly). The boot Continental System closes 10 of 26 continental ports; the SHUT OUT reading (congress._shut_out_reading) wants 13 of 26 (cs_shutout_pct 50) and no British corps on the Continent. France takes the two capitals the System's own history names: Lisbon (Portugal's 2 ports — Junot, 1807) with Soult, Rome (the Papal States' 1 port — 1808) with Massena from Milan, while Ney, Davout, Lannes, Murat and the Emperor keep the war with Austria in the field. Soult then turns on the British corps that land in Portugal (Paget, Wellesley): the SHUT OUT reading wants none of them standing on the Continent. A refused attack no longer costs the march (SR5B-1, found playing this arm). Pair with --declare-war proceed (the declarations are this arm's point) and --diplomacy accept. `turns` keys are the driver's 1-based LOOP INDEX (PC15-H).

1: declare war on the Papal States

_note_gr66: GR-66 (T0-I, November 7, 2026): every blind attack-by-name in loops 7-12 is GONE — Paget lands at Lisbon at T3 and stays (he no longer marches inland to Aragon), so a named attack with the man out of sight fell to an attack_target clarification whose FIRST answer is the nearest visible foe, and the driver's answer REWROTE Soult's Lisbon march to a pursuit of Archduke Charles at loop 7 (GR-18's trace, SYSTEMS_REFERENCE §181.3) — and, once the march was freed, to a battle with Bernardim Freire at loop 9. The march now completes and loop 8's 'Soult, attack Lisbon' meets whatever Britain has ashore on Lisbon's field: on austerlitz and marengo that is Shrapnel (landed T7 after Spain took Paget at T6) and Britain sues at T8; on historical Spain destroys Paget outright at T7, Britain lands no second corps inside the arm, and a court that has never fought France cannot sue her (the GR-18 ruling) — the per-seed truth, recorded in SYSTEMS_REFERENCE §184.
_note_variants: Two arms. ACCEPT (--diplomacy accept): the A2 sue-path — the driver takes Britain's suit when it comes, which is the arc's end. DECLINE (--diplomacy decline): the SHUT OUT arm — France keeps the war with Britain (at peace the System closes nothing: `closure_against` counts the ports of courts AT WAR with Britain, vassals, members and conquered capitals) while Lisbon and Rome fall and Soult hunts the British corps in Portugal. Massena's march to Rome is re-issued because cannon fire at Munich pulls him to the guns.
